incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call — automated quality alert triggered for routing policy 'cost-pref' at 06:12 UTC. Multiple customer requests show spike in hallucinations after policy routed traffic to variant opt-quant-4bit. Investigating impact and mitigation.

Alex Chen: I'm on it. Seeing elevated client error reports and user outrage threads. Which customers are affected?

Priya Patel: A few mid-market customers reported bad outputs (NLG hallucinations, factual errors). Support flagged 3 P1s so far. Impact window ~06:10-06:18 UTC.

Marco Ruiz: I can confirm increased failure rate on downstream reranker tests when model=opt-quant-4bit. Baseline with opt-fp16 is fine. Looks like quality delta > 12% on eval set.

Jordan Lee: @Priya can you paste support ticket IDs? we should correlate request IDs to routing decisions.

Priya Patel: Ticket #5342, #5343, #5344. Adding sample payloads to the thread.

Mei Tan: Quick note — autoscaling is healthy. This is not capacity. It's policy routing sending traffic to the cheaper variant. Might be a config regression in policy evaluation order.

Carlos Gomez: I pulled policy config from prod. policy id cost-pref (v3) has this rule at top:

```
- rule: prefer_cheapest
  match: customer_tier != enterprise
  action: route_to_variant(opt-quant-4bit)
```

We used to have quality_threshold check before prefer_cheapest; looks like it got removed in the last deploy.

Alex Chen: Can we hotfix by disabling prefer_cheapest or reordering rules? What's the command to flip?

Marco Ruiz: Runbook command:

```
# disable policy rule
redwoodctl routing update-policy --id=policy-cost-pref --patch '{"rules": ["remove:prefer_cheapest"]}'
```

Will try in 2 mins. @incident-bot please record change.

incident-bot: Change request queued by Marco Ruiz. Please confirm with on-call before apply.

Jordan Lee: I'm on-call. Marco proceed with patch and post the exact CLI output here.

Marco Ruiz: Applying patch now... executing.

```
> redwoodctl routing update-policy --id=policy-cost-pref --patch '{"rules": ["remove:prefer_cheapest"]}'
Success: rule prefer_cheapest removed. Policy v4 active.
```

Marco Ruiz: Confirmed policy v4 active. Traffic should stop going to opt-quant-4bit for non-enterprise tiers.

Priya Patel: Support reports customers seeing improved outputs after ~2 minutes post-change. Tickets #5342/#5343 marked recovering.

Mei Tan: Running quick A/B checks on 1000 sampled requests. Quality back to baseline with opt-fp16. No new latency regressions.

Carlos Gomez: Adding monitoring alert tweak: raise quality fallback threshold from 0.85 to 0.9 and add a guard to prevent route_to_variant unless eval_quality >= threshold.

Alex Chen: Good. We need a postmortem and to determine why the quality check was removed. Was this in recent infra change?

Jordan Lee: I see a config diff in infra repo from PR #782: owner @devops-template. That PR removed a deprecated guard when consolidating routing rules. Assigning to Marco + Mei to do root cause.

Marco Ruiz: Taking ownership of RCA. Immediate action items:
- Reintroduce quality guard to policy templates (done local)
- Add a pre-deploy config lint to catch removed critical guards
- Notify affected customers and offer credits if required

Priya Patel: I'll draft customer comms and coordinate with CS. Early recovery message ready to send.

Mei Tan: Suggest we also add synthetic evals that run when policy changes are rolled out to prod (smoke tests against golden prompts).

Carlos Gomez: I'll create a Grafana dashboard panel to show policy routing distribution by variant and quality delta—so we can detect divergence faster.

Jordan Lee: Reassigning on-call: @Jordan remains primary for the incident. If anything spikes, escalate to Eng-SRE. I'll prepare an incident Slack brief for execs.

incident-bot: Incident state updated: mitigation applied (policy rule removed). Severity downgraded to Sev-3. Time to mitigate: ~8 minutes. Please proceed with RCA and postmortem within 72 hours.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone. Add follow-ups in the incident doc: links to PR #782, policy change diff, tickets 5342-5344, and the CLI output.

Priya Patel: Copy that. I'll update support tickets and post customer messages.

Marco Ruiz: RCA notes incoming. Initial conclusion: accidental removal of quality guard during rule consolidation. Will propose safeguards in PRs and automated checks.

Mei Tan: Also adding a runtime failsafe: if a variant's production eval quality drops by >10% in a 5-minute window, automatically block route_to_variant for that variant.

Carlos Gomez: Filed a follow-up task: TASK-1294 for dashboard and TASK-1295 for automatic blocking.

Jordan Lee: Closing the page. If any regressions reappear, reopen immediately. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated). Logs and changes archived under incident/1919001234.
